title: Revisão de Prova - Inglês - Past Simple, Have to/Has to, Comparatives e Superlatives
description: Lista com 45 exercícios de revisão para prova, cobrindo Past Simple (verbos regulares e irregulares), Have to/Has to, Comparatives e Superlatives, baseados no material de revisão.

exercises.question: I _________ late for school yesterday. (to be)
exercises.explicacao: No passado simples, para 'I' usamos 'was'. I was late for school yesterday.
exercises.dica: Lembre-se: I was, you were, he/she/it was, we/they were.

exercises.question: She _________ meat and vegetables last week. (to eat)
exercises.explicacao: O verbo 'to eat' é irregular no passado: eat → ate.
exercises.dica: Verbos irregulares têm formas especiais no passado.

exercises.question: We _________ to the beach yesterday. (to go)
exercises.explicacao: O verbo 'to go' é irregular no passado: go → went.

exercises.question: He _________ an orange juice this morning. (to drink)
exercises.explicacao: O verbo 'to drink' é irregular no passado: drink → drank.

exercises.question: My sister _________ a chocolate cake last weekend. (to make)
exercises.explicacao: O verbo 'to make' é irregular no passado: make → made.

exercises.question: Did she eat meat and vegetables last week?
exercises.explicacao: Para perguntas com DID, usamos respostas curtas: Yes, she did / No, she didn't.
exercises.dica: Respostas curtas usam o auxiliar DID.

exercises.question: She _________ eat meat and vegetables last week. (negative)
exercises.explicacao: Na forma negativa do passado, usamos DIDN'T + verbo no infinitivo.
exercises.dica: DIDN'T é usado para negar ações no passado.

exercises.question: True or False: O verbo 'to be' no passado (was/were) usa o auxiliar DID nas formas negativa e interrogativa.
exercises.explicacao: False. O verbo 'to be' NÃO usa o auxiliar DID. Usamos: Was he hungry? / He wasn't hungry.
exercises.dica: To be é especial, não precisa de auxiliar.

exercises.question: Was he hungry?
exercises.explicacao: Para perguntas com WAS/WERE, usamos respostas curtas com was/were: Yes, he was / No, he wasn't.
exercises.dica: To be não usa DID nas respostas.

exercises.question: Suzy _________ dinner last night. (to cook)
exercises.explicacao: Para verbos regulares, adicionamos -ED ao infinitivo: cook → cooked.
exercises.dica: Verbos regulares terminam em -ED no passado.

exercises.question: You _________ your friend yesterday. (to call)
exercises.explicacao: Para verbos regulares terminados em -e, adicionamos apenas -d: call → called.

exercises.question: I _________ the water to make tea. (to boil)
exercises.explicacao: Para verbos regulares terminados em -e, adicionamos apenas -d: boil → boiled.

exercises.question: My mom _________ me prepare dinner. (to help)
exercises.explicacao: Para verbos regulares, adicionamos -ED: help → helped.

exercises.question: My father _________ drinking coffee. (to stop)
exercises.explicacao: Para verbos de uma sílaba terminados em consoante-vogal-consoante, dobramos a consoante final: stop → stopped.
exercises.dica: Stop termina em consoante-vogal-consoante, então dobramos o 'p'.

exercises.question: Did I boil the water?
exercises.explicacao: Para perguntas com DID, usamos respostas curtas: Yes, I did / No, I didn't.
exercises.dica: Respostas curtas usam o auxiliar DID.

exercises.question: I _________ boil the water. (negative)
exercises.explicacao: Na forma negativa do passado, usamos DIDN'T + verbo no infinitivo.
exercises.dica: DIDN'T é usado para negar ações no passado.

exercises.question: Which expression is used for past tense?
exercises.explicacao: Yesterday (ontem) é uma expressão de tempo usada com o passado simples.

exercises.question: Which expression is NOT used for past tense?
exercises.explicacao: Next Sunday (próximo domingo) é futuro, não passado. As outras opções são expressões de passado.

exercises.question: My friend _________ his rubber. (to lose)
exercises.explicacao: O verbo 'to lose' é irregular no passado: lose → lost.

exercises.question: My grandma _________ a new pair of shoes. (to buy)
exercises.explicacao: O verbo 'to buy' é irregular no passado: buy → bought.

exercises.question: She _________ to visit me after school. (to come)
exercises.explicacao: O verbo 'to come' é irregular no passado: come → came.

exercises.question: You _________ a beautiful butterfly. (to draw)
exercises.explicacao: O verbo 'to draw' é irregular no passado: draw → drew.

exercises.question: We _________ a lot of cool photos. (to take)
exercises.explicacao: O verbo 'to take' é irregular no passado: take → took.

exercises.question: They _________ on the floor to play board games. (to sit)
exercises.explicacao: O verbo 'to sit' é irregular no passado: sit → sat.

exercises.question: I _________ to clean my bedroom before going to my friend's house. (have to)
exercises.explicacao: Para I, you, we, they usamos 'have to'. Para he, she, it usamos 'has to'.
exercises.dica: Have to é usado para I, you, we, they.

exercises.question: He _________ wash the plates after dinner. (have to)
exercises.explicacao: Para he, she, it usamos 'has to'. Para I, you, we, they usamos 'have to'.
exercises.dica: Has to é usado para he, she, it.

exercises.question: She _________ make her bed before going to school. (have to)
exercises.explicacao: Para he, she, it usamos 'has to'.
exercises.dica: She é terceira pessoa do singular, então usa 'has to'.

exercises.question: I _________ have to wear glasses. (negative)
exercises.explicacao: Na forma negativa, usamos don't have to (para I, you, we, they) ou doesn't have to (para he, she, it).
exercises.dica: Don't have to é usado para I, you, we, they.

exercises.question: She _________ have to read the book again. (negative)
exercises.explicacao: Na forma negativa, para he, she, it usamos 'doesn't have to'.
exercises.dica: Doesn't have to é usado para he, she, it.

exercises.question: This place is too _________. We must not be here alone.
exercises.explicacao: Dangerous significa perigoso. Se não podemos estar sozinhos, o lugar é perigoso.
exercises.dica: Pense em um lugar onde não é seguro estar sozinho.

exercises.question: The Maths test was too _________. I didn't get a good grade.
exercises.explicacao: Difficult significa difícil. Se não conseguiu uma boa nota, o teste era difícil.
exercises.dica: Se não conseguiu boa nota, o teste era difícil.

exercises.question: I don't like this song. It's very _________.
exercises.explicacao: Boring significa chato/entediante. Se não gosta da música, ela é chata.
exercises.dica: Se não gosta, é porque é chato.

exercises.question: I'm _________ of snakes. I really don't like them.
exercises.explicacao: Afraid significa com medo. Se não gosta de cobras, tem medo delas.

exercises.question: The football game was very _________. We had a lot of fun.
exercises.explicacao: Exciting significa empolgante. Se se divertiram muito, o jogo foi empolgante.
exercises.dica: Se teve muita diversão, foi empolgante.

exercises.question: I got a 100 in my English test. The test was very _________.
exercises.explicacao: Easy significa fácil. Se tirou 100, o teste foi fácil.
exercises.dica: Se tirou nota máxima, o teste foi fácil.

exercises.question: Helen is _________ intelligent than Bob. (comparative)
exercises.explicacao: Para adjetivos longos, usamos MORE + adjetivo + THAN no comparativo.

exercises.question: Janet is _________ beautiful than Rose. (comparative)
exercises.explicacao: Beautiful é um adjetivo longo, então usamos MORE + beautiful + THAN.

exercises.question: He is _________ polite than his sister. (comparative)
exercises.explicacao: Polite é um adjetivo longo, então usamos MORE + polite + THAN.

exercises.question: Tigers are _________ exciting animals. (superlative)
exercises.explicacao: Para adjetivos longos no superlativo, usamos THE MOST + adjetivo.
exercises.dica: Superlativo de adjetivos longos usa 'the most'.

exercises.question: The exercise 2 is _________ difficult of all. (superlative)
exercises.explicacao: Para adjetivos longos no superlativo, usamos THE MOST + adjetivo.
exercises.dica: Superlativo usa 'the most' para adjetivos longos.

exercises.question: She is _________ happy girl I know. (superlative)
exercises.explicacao: Happy é um adjetivo longo no superlativo, então usamos THE MOST + happy.

exercises.question: Math is _________ difficult subject there is. (superlative)
exercises.explicacao: Para adjetivos longos no superlativo, usamos THE MOST + adjetivo.

exercises.question: Portuguese is _________ difficult than English. (comparative)
exercises.explicacao: Para adjetivos longos no comparativo, usamos MORE + adjetivo + THAN.

exercises.question: Pizza is _________ delicious than hamburger. (comparative)
exercises.explicacao: Delicious é um adjetivo longo, então usamos MORE + delicious + THAN no comparativo.

exercises.question: My grandpa is _________ generous than my uncle. (comparative)
exercises.explicacao: Generous é um adjetivo longo, então usamos MORE + generous + THAN no comparativo.
